note: Function exports of stock zombies scripts by script VM (patch_zm decompile, gsc-tool). An unqualified call to one of these from a module script on the same VM, without the matching #include, is an unresolved external at link time. A row only judges scripts of its own vm: a .csc never links against a server script, so server rows say nothing about a client script and the reverse. The server rows are the complete export lists of those eight scripts; the client rows carry only the names proven so far, so a client call this table does not hold stays not_counted rather than failed. `complete` says which: only a complete row can be read negatively, so `owner::name` naming a function a complete row does not list is a failed call, while the same shape against a partial row says nothing. `arity` carries each function's declared parameter count from the same decompile. GSC passes undefined for an argument a call omits, so a call resolves against a declaration whose parameter count is at least its own argument count; a call with more arguments than any reachable declaration accepts is an unresolved external at link, which no compiler reports.
